question.text: Cross-holding restriction for MFs per SEBI:

answer.text: Cap on single-issuer exposure (e.g., 10% debt, 10% equity)

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI limits: ~10% single-issuer, prevents concentration; sector caps also exist. The Trap: Exact limits vary by fund category. Cross-Exam Context: V-A detail. Manager's Pro-Tip: SEBI inspections check cap compliance — daily monitoring required.
